title: Aspect Pairs: Suffixes & Stems
descriptionRussian: Видовые пары с суффиксами и чередованием основ
intro: Not all aspect pairs are formed by adding prefixes! Some change their suffix: решать → решить (-ать becomes -ить). Others use completely different stems: говорить → сказать, брать → взять. These 'suppletive' pairs must be memorized, but the good news is there aren't many of them. Suffix pairs follow a predictable pattern, while stem-change pairs are the most common verbs you'll use every day.
rules: SUFFIX pattern: the ending changes from -ать/-ять to -ить: решать → решить, получать → получить, отвечать → ответить.
STEM CHANGE (suppletive): completely different words form a pair: говорить → сказать, брать → взять, класть → положить.
Suffix pairs often have consonant changes too: отвечать → ответить (ч → т), встречать → встретить (ч → т).
There are only about 10 common suppletive pairs — memorize them as vocabulary, not rules.
examples: решать / решить — to decide/solve (impf/pf), suffix change
получать / получить — to receive (impf/pf), suffix change
говорить / сказать — to speak/say (impf/pf), different stems
брать / взять — to take (impf/pf), different stems

items.prompt: What is the perfective pair of 'решать'?
items.promptEnglish: What is the perfective pair of 'решать'?

items.prompt: What is the imperfective pair of 'взять'?
items.promptEnglish: What is the imperfective pair of 'взять'?
items.hint: Different stem pair. This is a very common verb.
items.explanation: Взять (pf) ← брать (impf). Different stems, must be memorized.
The suffix changes from -ать to -ить. This is the suffix pattern.

items.prompt: What is the perfective pair of 'говорить'?
items.promptEnglish: What is the perfective pair of 'говорить'?
items.explanation: Говорить → сказать (different stems, must be memorized).

items.prompt: What is the perfective pair of 'отвечать'?
items.promptEnglish: What is the perfective pair of 'отвечать'?
items.explanation: Отвечать → ответить. Suffix change (-ать → -ить) plus consonant change (ч → т).

items.prompt: What is the imperfective pair of 'положить'?
items.promptEnglish: What is the imperfective pair of 'положить'?
items.hint: Different stem pair. This is a common verb meaning 'to put'.
items.explanation: Положить (pf) ← класть (impf). Different stems, must be memorized.

items.prompt: What is the perfective pair of 'покупать'?
items.promptEnglish: What is the perfective pair of 'покупать'?
items.hint: The prefix по- drops in the perfective
items.explanation: Покупать (impf) → купить (pf). An unusual pair where the prefix drops.

items.prompt: What is the perfective pair of 'встречать'?
items.promptEnglish: What is the perfective pair of 'встречать'?
items.explanation: Встречать → встретить. Suffix change plus consonant change (ч → т).

items.prompt: Which pair uses DIFFERENT STEMS (not suffix change)?
items.promptEnglish: Which pair uses DIFFERENT STEMS (not suffix change)?
items.hint: One of these pairs has completely unrelated words
items.explanation: Брать / взять are completely different words (suppletive pair). The others all follow the suffix pattern.

blanks: Я хочу _____ этот вопрос. (I want to solve this question.)
hints: Хотеть + infinitive. Solving a specific question implies a completed result.
explanations: After хотеть, use perfective infinitive when you want to complete a specific action. Решать → решить (suffix change).

minimalPairs.context: Он долго _____ задачу. (He solved the problem for a long time.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He solved the problem for a long time.
minimalPairs.explanation: Duration (долго) = imperfective process: решал. He was working on it.

minimalPairs.context: Наконец он _____ задачу! (Finally he solved the problem!)
minimalPairs.explanation: Completed result (наконец) = perfective: решил. He finished solving it.
